background.text: What R1 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a runner is in the process of collecting their bib and has been cleared to start, the system must hand out the bib.
What R2 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a runner collects a bib and is not cleared to start the race, the system must call the medical team.
What R7 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a heat warning is in force, the start gate must not be opened.
What R12 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a runner registers while places are still available, the system must confirm the registration for the new runner and hand out the bib.
background.formula: (=> (and (and runner_registered places_left) (and registration_confirmed bib_number_assigned)) (and confirmation_sent_to_new_runner bib_handed_out))

background.text: What X3 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: Whenever a runner transfers their registration to another runner, the system must confirm the registration.
What R21 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: When a runner withdraws from the race, the system must not refund the entry fee.
What R31 demands, in the terms of the other requirements: If a runner's finish time is below the course record, the system must inform the runner of the new time.

rules.text: WHEN a runner collects the bib AND the runner is cleared to start THEN the system hands out the bib and the timing chip
rules.reading: If a runner is collecting a bib and is cleared to start the race, the system must hand out both the bib and the timing chip.

probes.reading: The system hands out the bib if the runner is collecting it, and the system hands out the timing chip if the runner is cleared to start, provided the runner is collecting the bib.

rules.text: WHEN a runner collects the bib AND the runner is not cleared to start THEN the system sends the runner to the medical desk
rules.reading: If a runner is collecting their bib and is not cleared to start the race, the system must send that runner to the medical desk.

probes.reading: The system sends the runner to the medical desk only if the runner is collecting a bib and is not cleared to start.
If a runner is collecting a bib, then the system sends the runner to the medical desk only if the runner is not cleared to start.

rules.text: WHEN a start wave is called AND the runner belongs to the wave THEN the system opens the start gate for the runner
rules.reading: When a start wave is called and the runner belongs to that specific wave, the system must open the start gate for that runner.

rules.text: WHEN a start wave is called AND the runner does not belong to the wave THEN the system shows the runner the right wave
rules.reading: When a start wave is called for a runner who is not part of that specific wave, the system must display the correct wave information for that runner.

probes.reading: The system shows the runner the right wave only if a start wave is called and the runner does not belong to that wave.
If a start wave is called, then the system shows the runner the right wave only if the runner does not belong to the wave.

rules.text: WHEN a runner passes a checkpoint THEN the system records the split time of the runner
rules.reading: Whenever a runner passes a checkpoint, the system must record the split time for that runner.

probes.reading: The requirement implies that if the system records a split time, it must be because the runner passed a checkpoint (the recording is a direct and exclusive consequence of the pass event).
The system records the split time if and only if the runner passes a checkpoint, establishing a strict equivalence between the event and the system action.

rules.text: WHEN the cut-off time of a checkpoint has passed THEN the system closes the checkpoint
rules.reading: When the cut-off time of a checkpoint has passed, the system must close that checkpoint.

probes.reading: The system closes the checkpoint only if the cut-off time has passed, implying that the passage of the cut-off time is a necessary condition for closure, but not necessarily sufficient (e.g., the system might wait for a manual confirmation or a specific signal even after the time has passed).

rules.text: WHEN a heat warning is in force THEN the system shows the warning at the start area and does not open any start gate
rules.reading: If a heat warning is currently in force, the system must display the warning at the start area and must not open any start gate for runners.

probes.reading: The system shows the warning at the start area and does not open any start gate only when a heat warning is in force.

rules.text: WHEN a runner drops out AND the runner is injured THEN the system calls the medical team
rules.reading: If a runner drops out of the race and is injured, the system must call the medical team.

probes.reading: If a runner drops out of the race, the system must call the medical team, and the runner is injured.

rules.text: WHEN a runner drops out AND the runner is not injured THEN the system sends the sweep bus
rules.reading: If a runner drops out of the race and is not injured, the system must send the sweep bus.

probes.reading: The system sends the sweep bus only if the runner drops out and is not injured.
If a runner drops out, the system sends the sweep bus unless the runner is injured.

rules.text: WHEN a runner loses a timing chip for the second time THEN the system charges the runner for the chip
rules.reading: The system charges the runner for the timing chip when a runner loses a timing chip and the count of lost chips is exactly two.

probes.reading: The system charges the runner for the chip when a runner loses a timing chip and the count of lost chips is at least two.
The system charges the runner for the chip when a runner loses a timing chip and the count of lost chips is more than two.

rules.text: WHEN a runner asks for a pacer AND a pacer for the target time is free THEN the system assigns the pacer to the runner
rules.reading: If a runner requests a pacer and a pacer for the desired target time is currently available, the system must assign that pacer to the runner.

probes.reading: The system assigns the pacer to the runner if a pacer for the target time is free, regardless of whether the runner explicitly asked for one.
The system assigns the pacer to the runner only if the runner asks for a pacer, provided that a pacer for the target time is free.

rules.text: WHEN a runner registers AND places are left THEN the system confirms the registration and assigns a bib number
rules.reading: If a runner registers for the race and there are places available, the system must confirm the registration and assign a bib number.

probes.reading: The system confirms the registration and assigns a bib number only if the runner registers and places are left.
If a runner registers, the system confirms the registration and assigns a bib number only if places are left.

rules.text: WHEN a runner registers AND no places are left THEN the system puts the runner on the waiting list
rules.reading: When a runner registers for the race and there are no places left, the system must put the runner on the waiting list.

probes.reading: The system puts the runner on the waiting list only if the runner registers and no places are left.
If a runner registers, then the system puts the runner on the waiting list only if no places are left.

rules.text: WHEN a runner uploads a medical certificate AND the certificate is valid THEN the system marks the runner as cleared to start
rules.reading: If a runner uploads a medical certificate and that certificate is valid, the system must clear the runner to start the race.

probes.reading: The system clears the runner to start only if the runner has uploaded a medical certificate and that certificate is valid.
If a runner uploads a medical certificate, the system clears the runner to start only if the certificate is valid.

rules.text: WHEN a runner uploads a medical certificate AND the certificate is not valid THEN the system asks the runner for a new certificate
rules.reading: If a runner uploads a medical certificate and that certificate is not valid, the system must ask the runner for a new certificate.

probes.reading: If a runner uploads a medical certificate, the system asks for a new certificate if and only if the certificate is not valid.
The system asks for a new certificate whenever the certificate is not valid, regardless of whether the runner has uploaded it.

rules.text: WHEN a runner pays the entry fee AND the payment is accepted THEN the system sends the runner a receipt
rules.reading: When a runner attempts to pay the entry fee and that payment is successfully accepted, the system must send the runner a receipt.

probes.reading: The system sends a receipt only if the payment is accepted, regardless of whether a payment attempt was explicitly recorded.

rules.text: WHEN a runner pays the entry fee AND the payment is not accepted THEN the system asks for another payment method
rules.reading: If a runner attempts to pay the entry fee and that payment is rejected, the system must request a different payment method.

rules.text: WHEN a runner withdraws from the race THEN the system refunds the entry fee
rules.reading: When a runner withdraws from the race, the system must refund the entry fee.

probes.reading: The system refunds the entry fee only if the runner has withdrawn from the race.

rules.text: WHEN a runner misses the payment deadline for the second time THEN the system cancels the registration of the runner
rules.reading: When a runner misses the payment deadline and the count of missed deadlines is two, the system must cancel the runner's registration.

probes.reading: When a runner misses the payment deadline and the count of missed deadlines is at least two, the system must cancel the runner's registration.

rules.text: WHEN a runner transfers the registration to another runner THEN the system sends the new runner a confirmation
rules.reading: If a runner transfers their registration to another runner, the system must send a confirmation to the new runner.

probes.reading: The system sends a confirmation to the new runner only if the runner transfers the registration to another runner.

rules.text: WHEN a runner is a member of a running club THEN the system applies the club discount to the entry fee
rules.reading: If a runner is a member of a running club, the system must apply the club discount to their entry fee.

probes.reading: The system applies the club discount to the entry fee only if the runner is a member of a running club.

rules.text: WHEN a runner asks for a charity place AND the charity has places left THEN the system reserves a charity place for the runner
rules.reading: If a runner asks for a charity place and the specific charity still has available places, the system must reserve a place for that runner.

probes.reading: If a runner asks for a charity place, the system reserves a charity place for the runner only if the charity has places left.

rules.text: WHEN a runner asks for a charity place AND the charity has no places left THEN the system proposes another charity to the runner
rules.reading: When a runner requests a charity place and there are no remaining places for that charity, the system must propose an alternative charity.

probes.reading: The system proposes another charity whenever the runner asks for a charity place, regardless of whether the current charity has places left, but the proposal is specifically triggered by the lack of places in the context of the request.

rules.text: WHEN a runner withdraws from the race THEN the system keeps the entry fee
rules.reading: When a runner withdraws from the race, the system must keep the entry fee.

probes.reading: The system keeps the entry fee only if the runner has withdrawn from the race.

rules.text: WHEN the entry fee of a runner is unpaid THEN the system does not hand out any bib
rules.reading: If a runner's entry fee is unpaid, the system must not hand out the bib.

rules.text: WHEN a runner crosses the finish line THEN the system publishes the finish time of the runner
rules.reading: Whenever a runner crosses the finish line, the system must publish that runner's finish time.

probes.reading: The system publishes the finish time only if the runner has crossed the finish line.

rules.text: WHEN a protest against a result is open THEN the system does not publish any finish time
rules.reading: If a protest against a result is currently open, the system must not publish the finish time of the runner.

rules.text: WHEN a runner asks for a certificate AND the result of the runner is final THEN the system sends the certificate by email and adds the split times
rules.reading: When a runner requests a certificate and their race result is already final, the system must email the certificate to them and include the split times in it.

rules.text: WHEN a runner asks for a certificate AND the result of the runner is not final THEN the system tells the runner the date of the final results
rules.reading: When a runner requests a certificate and the race results are not yet final, the system must inform the runner of the date when the final results will be available.

probes.reading: The system tells the runner the date of the final results only if the runner asks for a certificate and the result is not final.

rules.text: WHEN the results of the race are final THEN the system ranks the runners in their age groups
rules.reading: Once the race results are finalized, the system must rank the runners within their respective age groups.

probes.reading: The system ranks the runners in their age groups only if the results of the race are final.

rules.text: WHEN a runner receives a warning from a referee for the third time THEN the system disqualifies the runner
rules.reading: If a runner receives a warning from a referee and the total number of warnings they have received is exactly three, the system must disqualify the runner.

probes.reading: If a runner receives a warning from a referee and the total number of warnings they have received is at least three, the system must disqualify the runner.
If a runner receives a warning from a referee and the total number of warnings they have received is more than three, the system must disqualify the runner.

rules.text: WHEN a runner asks for the finish photo AND the photo is available THEN the system sends the runner a link to the photo
rules.reading: If a runner requests a finish photo and that photo is available, the system must send the runner a link to the photo.

probes.reading: The system sends the link if the photo is available, regardless of whether the runner explicitly asked for it, as long as the runner has requested a photo at some point or the system proactively sends it when available.

rules.text: WHEN a runner asks for the finish photo AND the photo is not available THEN the system tells the runner when the photos will be ready
rules.reading: When a runner asks for the finish photo and the photo is not available, the system must tell the runner when the photos will be ready.

probes.reading: If the runner asks for the finish photo, then the system tells the runner when the photos will be ready only if the photo is not available.

rules.text: WHEN the finish time of a runner is below the course record THEN the system announces a new course record
rules.reading: If a runner's finish time is faster than the current course record, the system must announce a new course record.

probes.reading: The system announces a new course record only if the runner's finish time is below the course record.

rules.text: WHEN a referee corrects a finish time THEN the system informs the runner of the new time
rules.reading: Whenever a referee corrects a runner's finish time, the system must inform that runner of the updated time.

probes.reading: The system informs the runner of the new time only if a referee has corrected the finish time.

rules.text: WHEN a volunteer signs up for a shift AND the shift has places left THEN the system assigns the volunteer to the shift
rules.reading: If a volunteer signs up for a shift and places are still available in that shift, the system must assign the volunteer to that shift.

probes.reading: The system assigns the volunteer to the shift only if the volunteer signs up for a shift and the shift has places left.
If a volunteer signs up for a shift, the system assigns the volunteer to the shift only if the shift has places left.

rules.text: WHEN a volunteer signs up for a shift AND the shift has no places left THEN the system offers the volunteer another shift
rules.reading: If a volunteer signs up for a shift that is fully booked, the system must offer them a different shift.

probes.reading: If a volunteer signs up for a shift, the system offers another shift if and only if the shift has no places left.

rules.text: WHEN a volunteer checks in AND the volunteer has a shift on that day THEN the system prints the volunteer badge
rules.reading: Whenever a volunteer checks in and they have a scheduled shift on that specific day, the system must print their volunteer badge.

probes.reading: The system prints the volunteer badge if the volunteer checks in, provided that the volunteer has a shift on that day.
If a volunteer checks in, the system prints the volunteer badge only if the volunteer has a shift on that day.

rules.text: WHEN a volunteer checks in AND the volunteer has no shift on that day THEN the system shows the volunteer the date of the next shift
rules.reading: The system must display the date of the volunteer's next shift whenever a check-in event occurs and the volunteer does not have a scheduled shift for that specific day.

probes.reading: The system shows the date of the next shift if the volunteer checks in, and separately, the system ensures the volunteer does not have a shift on that day (which is a precondition for the check-in to be valid in this context).

rules.text: WHEN a volunteer misses a shift for the second time THEN the system removes the volunteer from the remaining shifts
rules.reading: When a volunteer misses a shift for the second time, the system removes the volunteer from the remaining shifts.

probes.reading: The system removes the volunteer from the remaining shifts if the volunteer has missed a shift at least twice.

rules.text: WHEN a volunteer finishes a shift THEN the system issues a meal voucher
rules.reading: Whenever a volunteer finishes a shift, the system must issue a meal voucher.

probes.reading: The system issues a meal voucher only if the volunteer has finished a shift.

rules.text: WHEN the briefing of a shift has started THEN the system shows the briefing room on the volunteer screens
rules.reading: If the briefing of a shift has started, the system must display the briefing room on the volunteer screens.

probes.reading: The system shows the briefing room on the volunteer screens only if the briefing of a shift has started.

rules.text: WHEN a volunteer asks for a T-shirt AND the size is in stock THEN the system hands out the T-shirt
rules.reading: If a volunteer requests a T-shirt and the specific size is available in inventory, the system must hand out the T-shirt.

probes.reading: The system hands out the T-shirt if the size is in stock, regardless of whether the volunteer explicitly asked for it.
The system hands out the T-shirt if the volunteer asks for it, regardless of whether the size is in stock.

rules.text: WHEN a volunteer asks for a T-shirt AND the size is not in stock THEN the system notes the size for the next delivery
rules.reading: If a volunteer asks for a T-shirt and the requested size is not in stock, the system must note the size for the next delivery.

probes.reading: If a volunteer asks for a T-shirt, the system notes the size for the next delivery, and the size is not in stock.
